filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Mon Nov 16 (after the morning run) – Tue Nov 17 morning PT (items already on the Nov 13–16 briefs not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: CRM vendors are setting the terms for outside AI agents: HubSpot now includes Claude and ChatGPT connector use in every seat and charges credits only for governed agent work, while Attio says agent-run tasks rose 20x in the month since it opened its data to SQL queries.

bullets.text: Nov 17: HubSpot says every seat includes enough headless access to do everyday work from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Copilot at no extra cost; third-party agents on existing APIs count against the plan's API capacity; a governed agent environment with per-agent permissions and action logs runs on HubSpot Credits.

Nov 16: Attio reports a 20x rise in tasks run by AI agents (Ask Attio and outside agents via MCP) since its Oct launch of a Postgres-compatible SQL engine whose queries run with the caller's permissions; 35,000+ companies use Attio, and Ramp's November data names it the fastest-growing CRM vendor.

Nov 17: Spara launched Scout, a free always-on seller assistant that watches job changes, company news and CRM activity, drafts outreach in the rep's voice, delivers it in Slack or SMS and can join calls. Spara reports a 10.5% reply rate versus 3.5% for standard sequences.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA reports Q3 today under an interim CEO, after a new chip-rental rule
biggest_ai_news.body: Results ~1:20 PM PT, call 2 PM PT (consensus ~$109B revenue). Nov 16: Commerce issued a rule requiring overseas data centers to vet customers and adding license requirements for Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil; Nov 17: NVIDIA's board formed a national security and export control committee.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic IPO likely to price above $70–$78
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 17: CNBC reports books close 4 PM ET today and pricing is likely above range; Bloomberg reported orders near 7x the shares offered. Nasdaq trading as ANT starts Nov 19.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI adds computer-use agents to ChatGPT for Healthcare
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 16: more than 20 healthcare plugins, improved clinical search, and computer-use agents for clinical and administrative workflows.

what_changed.title: HubSpot prices headless access for AI agents
what_changed.body: Nov 17: connector use from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot (plus MCP server and Agent CLI) is included in every seat; bring-your-own agents use existing API capacity; a governed agent environment with purpose-built agentic APIs, per-agent access controls and an action log is billed in HubSpot Credits. Power users can add capacity with credits instead of a new seat type.

what_changed.title: Salesforce: Carter shopper agent GA; joins Personal Agent Protocol
what_changed.body: Nov 17: Carter, a shopper agent for B2C Commerce with four prebuilt subagents (Product Expert, Site FAQ, Cart, Order Confirmation), is generally available as an add-on. Nov 16: Salesforce joined Sierra and Meta's Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) v1.0 as a launch partner and plans to bring it to Commerce Cloud on top of Google's UCP.

what_changed.title: Attio: agent-run tasks up 20x in a month
what_changed.body: Nov 16: Attio attributes the rise to its October architecture (SQL engine with caller permissions, live BI connectors, Activities beta); 35,000+ customers; Ramp November spend data names it the fastest-growing CRM vendor.

what_changed.title: Spara launches Scout, a free proactive seller assistant
what_changed.body: Nov 17: monitors signals across a rep's accounts, drafts outreach for approval, delivers through Slack and SMS, can join live calls; early users sent 8x more personalized emails and booked 29% more meetings (company figures). Spara has raised $20M.

quiet_note: No new launch, funding, M&A or pricing from Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco dated Nov 16–17. Clay's Nov 16 engineering post on Claygent auto-mode (47% cheaper than routing every task to a frontier model) covers a feature first shipped in October; its Nov 16 changelog roundup covers the week of Nov 9. Salesloft newsroom still tops out at Oct 27; Gong's November release (Agent Builder) dates to Nov 9.

market_direction.text: HubSpot includes connector use per seat but bills governed agent work in credits (Nov 17); Attio reports 20x agent-task growth (Nov 16).

market_direction.label: Accelerating (agent identity and consent standards)
market_direction.text: Salesforce joined Poppy so brands can verify and choose which shopper agents to admit (Nov 16).

market_direction.label: New (proactive seller assistants)
market_direction.text: Spara Scout acts on account signals without a prompt and delivers through Slack and SMS (Nov 17).

market_direction.label: Steady (core watchlist)
market_direction.text: No new launches from Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco.

HubSpot's credit-billed space where outside agents get agentic APIs, scoped permissions and an action record (Nov 17).
Attio's description of itself as a platform where agents and sellers work on the same live data (Nov 16).

competitive_moves.text: Carter shopper agent GA for B2C Commerce (Nov 17); joined Personal Agent Protocol v1.0 as a launch partner (Nov 16).
Reports 20x growth in agent-run tasks one month after its SQL/hybrid architecture launch (Nov 16).

watch.title: Today: Microsoft Ignite keynote (10 AM PT) and NVIDIA Q3 (1:20 PM PT); Anthropic pricing tonight or Wednesday; Claude Data default-on for Enterprise Nov 20
watch.body: Microsoft is positioning Agent 365 as the observability, governance and spend layer for agents, with the Book of News due after the keynote. NVIDIA's first report since Huang's exit lands a day after the chip-rental rule. Claude's own page puts Claude Data's Enterprise default-on date at Nov 20 (not Nov 19 as noted earlier).

interpretation.fact: Nov 17 HubSpot included agent connector use in every seat and put governed third-party agent work on credits. Nov 16 Attio reported 20x growth in agent-run tasks. Nov 17 Salesforce made Carter GA; Nov 16 it joined Personal Agent Protocol. Nov 17 Spara launched Scout. Nov 16 Commerce issued a chip-rental rule; Nov 17 NVIDIA formed a national security committee ahead of results today. Nov 17 CNBC reported Anthropic is likely to price above range. Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft and Monaco announced nothing new Nov 16–17.
interpretation.interpretation: With both HubSpot and Attio treating outside agents as primary users, the pricing fight is moving from seats to agent access: basic reads and writes from Claude or ChatGPT are becoming table stakes, and vendors are charging for governance, context and scale instead.
